name: vertex-erp
description: Vertex ERP — Enterprise ERP & Integrated Workflow Platform. Demo build for Shahjalal Islami Bank PLC.

scripts.setup: prisma generate && npm run db:reset-file && npm run reset
scripts.db:reset-file: rm -f prisma/vertex.db prisma/vertex.db-journal prisma/vertex.db-wal prisma/vertex.db-shm && prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run verify && npm run test:nav && npm run test:thread
